newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Kolenergo up 11 pct- trader says one order.
newsitem.headline: Russia Kolenergo up 11 pct- trader says one order.

text.p: Shares in Russian regional utility Kolenergo rose 11.4 percent at 1345 GMT on Wednesday to $0.420 from Tuesday's closing $0.377.
Reported volume on the Russian Trading System was 2.4 million shares and one trader said a single order for around three million shares was causing the move.
Prefs of the utility, located on the Kola peninsula in the Russian Arctic, also rose to $0.310 from $0.278 on 1.4 million shares reported turnover.
